# Storage Categories

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List storage categories

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories`

Retrieve a paginated list of storage categories with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, creator, locations | `company,locations` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by category name | `Heavy` |
| `filter[allow_new_products]` | string | No | Filter by allow_new_products enum values | `mixed` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories?include=company%2Clocations&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Heavy&filter%5Ballow_new_products%5D=mixed&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories?include=company%2Clocations&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Heavy&filter%5Ballow_new_products%5D=mixed&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories?include=company%2Clocations&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Heavy&filter%5Ballow_new_products%5D=mixed&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',

```

## Create storage category

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories`

Create a new storage category

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Storage category name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `max_weight` | number | No | Maximum allowed weight. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999. |
| `allow_new_products` | string | Yes | Policy for new products. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Heavy Goods",
  "max_weight": 500,
  "allow_new_products": "mixed",
  "company_id": 1
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "Heavy Goods",
  "max_weight": 500,
  "allow_new_products": "mixed",
  "company_id": 1
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'Heavy Goods',
    'max_weight' => 500,
    'allow_new_products' => 'mixed',
    'company_id' => 1,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/storage-categories"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "Heavy Goods",
    "max_weight": 500,
    "allow_new_products": "mixed",
    "company_id": 1,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />

```json

    "sort": 0,
```
